idea-plugin.name: Spring API Change Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Detect potentially breaking Spring REST API changes directly inside IntelliJ IDEA by comparing the current API surface with the version stored at Git HEAD.

Detects endpoint additions and removals, HTTP method and path changes, request parameter and request-body changes, and response type changes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Initial release of Spring API Change Guard.

  • Detect Spring REST API changes against Git HEAD.
  • Detect endpoint, HTTP method, path, parameter, request-body, and response type changes.
  • Display detected API changes inside IntelliJ IDEA.
